resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Idaho County list say 1935; the Nez Perce NF list says 1934 (plus or minus). Recorded as 1935 with the disagreement noted.

An earlier version attributed 'c.1934: 30-foot tower with L-4 cab' to O'Hara Point. That line sits under unit 31N-10E-11, not O'Hara's unit 31N-8E-29, so it was removed. All four listings give 20 feet.

notes_for_editor: The Idaho County list's O'Hara Point block (unit 31N-8E-29) reads 1935, a 20-foot tower with L-4 cab, and c.1955 destroyed. The c.1934, 30-foot line an earlier version attributed to O'Hara belongs to unit 31N-10E-11 and has been removed. The Nez Perce list is a Forest Service compilation and is the most formal source here; an editor may prefer its 1934 date (plus or minus). No cause for the 1955 loss and no staffing or fire history found in any source read.
